item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day has a lot of built-in checkpoints: a morning statement, a midday pause, and an afternoon question about projecting and mind reading. Those aren't decoration. They're where mindset actually gets practiced. When one comes up, stop and answer it honestly instead of just reading it. Don't treat them as a checklist. Action: at your midday check, say out loud one story you're telling yourself, then ask if it's a fact.
